title: वक्त
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a wide landscape literary editorial illustration for the humorous Hindi personal essay 'वक्त'. Core visual joke: personified Time has been asked to do monthly expenses on a laptop and is now trapped inside spreadsheet cell B7, bewildered and mildly offended. Make Time a small whimsical nonhuman clock-faced figure with thin ink-like arms and dangling legs, contained in one visibly selected green-bordered spreadsheet cell on a laptop screen. The laptop sits on a lived-in wooden desk in an ordinary Indian room on a languid hot summer afternoon. A wall clock and open window with a tiny sparrow on the wire can quietly reinforce the scene. Focus strongly on laptop and Time; no human portrait or realistic man. The clock-faced figure is comically exasperated, not frightened. Painterly gouache storybook style with soft paper grain, warm ochre sunlight and muted teal shadows, affectionate understated deadpan humour, similar to a hand-painted literary magazine illustration. Landscape approximately 3:2, important subjects inside central area for social cropping. The spreadsheet should read as clean grid cells, mostly empty, with the tiny cell reference 'B7' if legible; no other text, words, brand logos, captions or watermark. No photorealism, no identifiable real person, no extra fantasy characters.
note: Requested illustration added above original prose and used for sharing and list thumbnails; the earlier typographic card remains available as an unused fallback asset.
